name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_description: ₹6,000 per year delivered in 3 equal four-monthly installments directly to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.

exclusions: Income tax payer in last assessment year
Serving or retired government officer or employee
Constitutional post holder
Monthly pension exceeding ₹10,000
Institutional landholders

edge_cases: Joint land ownership / undivided ancestral land records (Khatauni) require co-owner partition or affidavit.
Tenant farmers or sharecroppers without title deed do not qualify directly without state-specific mutation.
Land acquired after cutoff date (01-02-2019) eligible only via succession/inheritance.

name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (पीएम-जय)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit_description: ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary cashless hospitalization across empaneled hospitals.

exclusions: Income tax payer
Government employees and organized sector workers with ESI/CGHS
Owns motorized 3/4 wheeler or mechanized agricultural equipment
Pucca house with 3+ rooms

edge_cases: Family listed in SECC 2011 or NFSA ration card database is auto-eligible even if recent income documentation is pending.
Senior citizens aged 70+ in family qualify for top-up coverage under expanded Ayushman Vay Vandana.

name: PMAY-G (Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin)
benefit_description: Financial grant of ₹1,20,000 (plains) / ₹1,30,000 (hilly/northeastern states) in direct installments for pucca house construction, plus 90 days MGNREGA wages.

exclusions: Family already owns a pucca brick/concrete house anywhere in India
Owns motorized two/three/four wheeler
Income tax payer or government employee in family
Family possesses Kisan Credit Card with credit limit of ₹50,000 or above

edge_cases: Kutcha house roof made of grass/thatch qualifies; partially bricked walls with unpaved tin roof require Gram Sabha verification.
Landless rural families eligible for free homestead land allocation via District Administration.
required_documents: MGNREGA Job Card (for 90 days wage integration)
Photograph of existing kutcha house structure
Affidavit of no pucca house anywhere
application_mode: Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office / AwaasSoft

name: KCC (Kisan Credit Card)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_description: Credit limit up to ₹3,00,000 with subvention interest rate of 4% per annum for timely repayments, covering crop production and animal husbandry.

exclusions: Defaulter with existing non-performing agricultural loan from commercial/cooperative banks

edge_cases: Tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers qualify under Joint Liability Groups (JLG) without land title.
Animal husbandry & fisheries farmers qualify for standalone credit limit up to ₹2,00,000.
required_documents: Land Title Deed / Record of Rights (Khasra) or JLG Lease Agreement
Cropping Pattern Certificate from Village Revenue Officer (Patwari)
application_mode: Bank Branch / CSC / PM-KISAN Portal Linkage

name: PM-KMY (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_description: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 (₹36,000 annually) upon attaining 60 years of age.

exclusions: Cultivable landholding exceeds 2.0 hectares (5 acres)
Enrolled in any other statutory social security scheme (NPS, ESIC, EPFO)
Income tax payer

edge_cases: Applicant aged exactly 40 is eligible; age 41 is strictly disqualified by central pension rules.
Monthly contribution (₹55 - ₹200 depending on entry age) can be auto-debited directly from PM-KISAN installments.
required_documents: Khasra/Khatauni Land Record proving holding <= 2 hectares

name: PMJJBY (Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana)
benefit_description: ₹2,00,000 life insurance cover payable to nominee on death of the insured due to any cause, for annual premium of ₹436.

exclusions: Age above 50 at entry (cover extends until age 55 if enrolled by age 50)

edge_cases: Auto-debit consent required on bank account; lien must clear by May 31 each year.
required_documents: Savings Bank Account with Auto-Debit Mandate

name: PMSBY (Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana)
benefit_description: ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or total permanent disability (₹1,00,000 for partial disability) for nominal annual premium of ₹20.

exclusions: Age above 70 at entry

edge_cases: Multiple accounts with different banks can only hold one active PMSBY claim.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit_description: Compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursement plus maintenance allowance up to ₹48,000 per academic year.

exclusions: Family income exceeds ₹2,50,000 per annum
Student already availing any other government scholarship
General category students (covered under separate EWS merit schemes)

edge_cases: OBC category income limit is strictly ₹2,50,000 non-creamy layer; requires Tahsildar certificate.
Dual degree or repeater courses require special institute clearance.
required_documents: Fee Receipt & Bonafide Certificate from College

name: Lakhpati Didi (NRLM - DAY)
benefit_description: Support to achieve sustainable annual household income of ₹1,00,000 or more through SHG community investment fund, technical training, and market access.

exclusions: Male applicants
Non-rural residents without local Gram Panchayat SHG presence

edge_cases: Individual woman not yet in an SHG can be fast-tracked for cluster federations through nearest Gram Panchayat Village Organization.
Existing SHG members with small trade proposals get interest-subvented bank loans.
application_mode: Gram Panchayat / Self Help Group VO / BDO

name: PM Mudra Yojana (Shishu Loan)
benefit_description: Collateral-free business loan up to ₹50,000 for starting or expanding micro-enterprises, shops, tailoring, or artisanal trades at regulated interest.

exclusions: Defaulter with any commercial or cooperative bank
Large corporations or non-micro enterprises

edge_cases: No collateral or third-party guarantee required by law; processing fee waived for Shishu category.
Vendor certificate or trade quotation serves as proof of enterprise.
required_documents: Proof of Business Address / Trade Idea
